sentences.text: Task 1. You are going to listen to a meeting where Helen, Mike and John discuss with Helen’s teacher, Ms.
Stanley, the background and ideas for the project.
Listen to the meeting and write the missing information in the spaces provided in the note sheet The first has been provided as an example.
You now have 30 seconds to study the task.
At the end of the task you You will have one minute to tidy up your answers.
Good morning. Come in all of you and sit down.
Now Helen, can you introduce me to your friends?
Well, this is John and this is Mike.
Hello Miss Stanley.
Nice to meet you Mike.
Good morning, Miss Stanley Morning John.
Well, thanks for helping out.
Okay, let's get started shall we.
So I finalize the dates of the project.
You need to have the first YouTube clip completed in two weeks on the 23rd of February.
That way we can spot any problems on the production side of things early on.
Is the 23rd okay for everyone?
Yes, no problem.
Fine with me.
Good. Now, I’m giving you about three months to do all six of the YouTube clips.
So that will be the 17th of May.
I hope you guys are good at sticking to a deadline.
Okay. Let’s move on to the next thing then, shall we?
Helen. yes. Tell me, Who is doing what in this project?
Yes, well, let’s see.
I want to direct the clips and interview people.
I'd love to direct something.
Oh, and, and yes, I'll also be helping out John with writing scripts That’s good because I’m going to need some help with the writing!
Helen told me you'd done a bit of editing John, is that right?
That's right. I’ve done some editing before.
I just hope I’ll be able to manage.
Okay. Mike what would you like to do?
I want to do the recording and look after the equipment.
I’ve got a lot of experience.
Mike is very good at fixing things.
He even fixed my iPhone!
Fixing stuff is easy.
So shall we have a look at the ideas you've come up with for the theme for all of the clips?
Well, we have four ideas for the themes.
The one I like most is Hong Kong’s wild animals, I think that it’s a topic not many people really know about and there’s a lot of wildlife in Hong Kong Yes, I like that idea.
Actually, come to think of it I know someone who might be able to help you.
He works in an animal shelter in the New Territories.
Maybe you could interview him.
His name is Brad.
Brad. B -R -A -D Like the Hollywood actor?
Yes, that’s right.
Ive got his email address on my phone.
Do you want me to text it to you?
Just tell me it and I'll type it into my now.
Okay here it is.
The email address is wildtamer at gmail .com.
Is that W -I -L -D -T -A -M -E -R?
That's right. All one word W -I -L -D -T -A -M -E -R.
and gmail is spelled G -M -A -I -L.
Oh, I know how to spell gmail.
Okay. That's enough of that I think.
So, does anyone want to suggest other ideas?
To be honest, I actually prefer my idea.
I was thinking of interviewing people who have unusual hobbies.
You know, like people who dress up as cartoon characters or go hunting UFOs.
Hmm, Unusual hobbies.
Maybe. Have you got somebody in mind to interview?
you? well, no.
Not really. Well, you'd need to think about somebody to contact then.
I know I've mentioned it before.
but I'd like to suggest that we make some clips about important places in Hong Kong.
Oh not this again.
Thank you Mike.
Can I hear your idea John?
Well, I thought it would be nice to tell people about places in Hong Kong that are important in some way.
You know, historically or culturally.
Well, that seems like a very good idea too.
I actually found an article about this the other day.
You could use it to add some interesting information.
Oh, I have one more idea.
I think it could be really amazing.
Yes? We could do something about ghosts of Hong Kong.
Hmm. Oh no.
Not ghosts! Well, I’m not sure about that.
It's going to be difficult to arrange an interview with a ghost.
Very difficult! So which theme do you think we should choose?
Well, wild animals and important places in Hong Kong seem to have a lot of potential but why don’t you guys discuss it more and give me your final decision later.
Now, before we finish for today I have some good news for you.
You have been given a budget of $2 ,000 for the project.
What can we spend it on?
Oh, just little things, you know, like stationery or food when you're out recording, oh and transport.
maybe gifts. gifts.
Gifts? Yes, gifts for people you interview.
It could be a drink or some food just to say thank you.
Okay? Oh, and, one more thing.
Don’t forget to pick up the smart card from the office so you can get into the studio when you need to.
No problem. I'll get the smart card now.
Thanks for your help Miss Stanley.
Bye. Thank you Miss Stanley.
Bye bye. That is the end of Task 1.
